import APPTReview.LacunaryEnergy

open scoped BigOperators
namespace APPTReview

/-- Weighted Cauchy--Schwarz with a total weight bound. -/
theorem fractional_weight_cauchy {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (w y : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (hw : ∀ i∈S,0≤w i) (hw1 : ∀ i∈S,w i≤1)
    (hr : (∑ i∈S,w i)≤r) :
    (∑ i∈S,w i*y i) ≤ Real.sqrt (r*(∑ i∈S,(y i)^2)) := by
  have hc := Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul S
    (r:=fun i => w i*y i) (f:=w) (g:=fun i => w i*(y i)^2)
    hw (fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sq_nonneg _))
    (fun i _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w i*y i)])
  have hq : (∑ i∈S,w i*(y i)^2) ≤ ∑ i∈S,(y i)^2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    nlinarith [hw1 i hi,sq_nonneg (y i)]
  have hp := mul_le_mul hr hq
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sq_nonneg _)))
    ((Finset.sum_nonneg hw).trans hr)
  exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (hc.trans hp)

end APPTReview

namespace APPTReview

/-- Exact low/middle/high estimate, uniform over the finite index set. -/
theorem fractional_strip_localization {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (w y : ι → ℝ)
    (r T a b : ℝ) (hw : ∀ i∈S,0≤w i) (hw1 : ∀ i∈S,w i≤1)
    (hy : ∀ i∈S,0≤y i) (hr : (∑ i∈S,w i)≤r)
    (hT : (∑ i∈S,(y i)^2)≤T) (ha : 0≤a) (hb : 0<b) (hab : a≤b) :
    (∑ i∈S,w i*y i) ≤ a*r+T/b+
      Real.sqrt (r*(∑ i∈S.filter (fun i => a≤y i ∧ y i≤b),(y i)^2)) := by
  classical
  let M := S.filter (fun i => a≤y i ∧ y i≤b)
  have hsplit : (∑ i∈S,w i*y i)=
      (∑ i∈S,if y i<a then w i*y i else 0)+
      (∑ i∈S,if b<y i then w i*y i else 0)+(∑ i∈M,w i*y i) := by
    rw [show (∑ i∈M,w i*y i)=∑ i∈S,if a≤y i ∧ y i≤b then w i*y i else 0 by
      exact Finset.sum_filter _ _]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    by_cases hlow : y i<a
    · have hhigh : ¬b<y i := by linarith
      simp [hlow,hhigh,not_le.mpr hlow]
    · by_cases hhigh : b<y i
      · simp [hlow,hhigh,not_le.mpr hhigh]
      · simp [hlow,hhigh,le_of_not_gt hlow,le_of_not_gt hhigh]
  have hlow : (∑ i∈S,if y i<a then w i*y i else 0)≤a*r := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i∈S,a*w i := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        split_ifs with ht
        · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (hw i hi) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.le)]
        · exact mul_nonneg ha (hw i hi)
      _ = a*(∑ i∈S,w i) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr ha
  have hhigh : (∑ i∈S,if b<y i then w i*y i else 0)≤T/b := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i∈S,(y i)^2/b := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        split_ifs with ht
        · have hwy : w i*y i≤y i := by nlinarith [hw1 i hi,hy i hi]
          exact hwy.trans ((le_div_iff₀ hb).2 (by nlinarith [hy i hi]))
        · exact div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hb.le
      _ = (∑ i∈S,(y i)^2)/b := (Finset.sum_div _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hT hb.le
  have hsub : M⊆S := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hM : (∑ i∈M,w i)≤r :=
    (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun i hi _ => hw i hi)).trans hr
  have hmid := fractional_weight_cauchy M w y r
    (fun i hi => hw i (hsub hi)) (fun i hi => hw1 i (hsub hi)) hM
  rw [hsplit]
  linarith

end APPTReview

import APPTReview.LacunaryUniformBand
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.WithDensity

open scoped BigOperators NNReal ENNReal
open MeasureTheory Set
namespace APPTReview

noncomputable def finiteAtomicMeasure {ι X : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace X]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → X) : Measure X :=
  Measure.sum (fun i => (ENNReal.ofReal (p i)) • Measure.dirac (x i))

theorem finiteAtomicMeasure_probability {ι X : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace X]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → X) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hs : (∑ i,p i)=1) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (finiteAtomicMeasure p x) := by
  constructor
  simp only [finiteAtomicMeasure,Measure.sum_apply_of_countable,Measure.smul_apply,measure_univ,
    smul_eq_mul,mul_one,tsum_fintype]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hp i),hs,ENNReal.ofReal_one]

noncomputable def finiteAtomicProbability {ι X : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace X]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → X) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hs : (∑ i,p i)=1) :
    ProbabilityMeasure X := ⟨finiteAtomicMeasure p x,finiteAtomicMeasure_probability p x hp hs⟩

/-- Repeated atom locations and zero weights are permitted. -/
theorem finiteAtomicMeasure_real {ι X : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace X]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass X] (p : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → X) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i)
    (S : Set X) [DecidablePred (fun i => x i∈S)] :
    (finiteAtomicMeasure p x).real S=∑ i,if x i∈S then p i else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [Measure.real,finiteAtomicMeasure,Measure.sum_apply_of_countable,Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.dirac_apply,Set.indicator_apply,Pi.one_apply,smul_eq_mul,tsum_fintype]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun i _ => by split_ifs <;> simp)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : x i∈S <;> simp [hi,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp i)]

/-- Exact product formula for the ordered pairs of original atoms. -/
theorem finiteAtomicMeasure_prod {ι κ X Y : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (q : κ → ℝ) (x : ι → X) (y : κ → Y)
    (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hq : ∀ j,0≤q j) :
    (finiteAtomicMeasure p x).prod (finiteAtomicMeasure q y)=
      finiteAtomicMeasure (fun z : ι×κ => p z.1*q z.2) (fun z => (x z.1,y z.2)) := by
  simp only [finiteAtomicMeasure,Measure.prod_sum,Measure.prod_smul_left,
    Measure.prod_smul_right,Measure.dirac_prod_dirac,smul_smul]
  congr 1
  funext z
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hp z.1),mul_comm]

theorem finiteAtomicMeasure_map {ι X Y : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → X) (f : X → Y) (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measure.map f (finiteAtomicMeasure p x)=finiteAtomicMeasure p (fun i => f (x i)) := by
  simp only [finiteAtomicMeasure,Measure.map_sum hf.aemeasurable,
    Measure.map_smul _ hf.aemeasurable,Measure.map_dirac' hf]

end APPTReview

import FiniteProbability
import APPTReview.BaselineGraph

open scoped BigOperators NNReal
open MeasureTheory Set
namespace APPTReview

/-- The finite atomic measure is the actual distribution of the scale coordinates. -/
theorem scaleLift_atomic {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ)
    (x : ι → ScaleInterval) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hs : (∑ i,p i)=1) :
    (scaleLift (finiteAtomicProbability p x hp hs)).toMeasure=
      finiteAtomicMeasure p (fun i => (x i).val) := by
  exact finiteAtomicMeasure_map p x (fun t : ScaleInterval => t.val) measurable_subtype_coe

/-- Exact empirical two-coordinate band mass, with no assumption of distinct atoms. -/
theorem atomic_scaleBand_mass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ)
    (x : ι → ScaleInterval) (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hs : (∑ i,p i)=1) (d t : ℝ) :
    (scaleLift (finiteAtomicProbability p x hp hs) |>.prod
      (scaleLift (finiteAtomicProbability p x hp hs))).toMeasure.real (scaleBand d t)=
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (if |((x i).val:ℝ)+((x j).val:ℝ)-d|≤t then p i*p j else 0) := by
  classical
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_prod,scaleLift_atomic p x hp hs,
    finiteAtomicMeasure_prod p p _ _ hp hp,
    finiteAtomicMeasure_real (fun z : ι×ι => p z.1*p z.2) (fun z : ι×ι => ((x z.1).val,(x z.2).val)) (fun z => mul_nonneg (hp z.1) (hp z.2))]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,scaleBand,Set.mem_setOf_eq]

/-- Splitting a symmetric finite matrix into diagonal and the two half triangles. -/
theorem symmetric_pair_sum {m : ℕ} (F : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i j,F i j=F j i) :
    (∑ i,∑ j,F i j)=(∑ i,F i i)+2*(∑ p : UpperPair m,F p.val.1 p.val.2) := by
  have hs := (squareSlotEquiv m).sum_comp (fun p : Fin m×Fin m => F p.1 p.2)
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type,Fintype.sum_sum_type] at hs
  change (∑ i,F i i)+((∑ p : UpperPair m,F p.val.1 p.val.2)+
    (∑ p : UpperPair m,F p.val.2 p.val.1))=∑ p : Fin m×Fin m,F p.1 p.2 at hs
  have he : (∑ p : UpperPair m,F p.val.2 p.val.1)=∑ p : UpperPair m,F p.val.1 p.val.2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p _
    exact hF _ _
  rw [he,Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hs
  linarith

theorem upperPair_mass_le_half {m : ℕ} (F : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i j,F i j=F j i) (hdiag : ∀ i,0≤F i i) :
    (∑ p : UpperPair m,F p.val.1 p.val.2)≤(∑ i,∑ j,F i j)/2 := by
  have he := symmetric_pair_sum F hF
  have hd : 0≤∑ i,F i i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hdiag i)
  linarith

end APPTReview

import FinitePairMass
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

open scoped BigOperators NNReal
namespace APPTReview

noncomputable def schmidtScalePoint (L x : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) (hx : 0≤x) (hx1 : x≤1) :
    ScaleInterval :=
  ⟨⟨max 0 (1+2*Real.log x/L),le_max_left _ _⟩,
    by
      constructor
      · exact bot_le
      · change max (0:ℝ) (1+2*Real.log x/L)≤1
        apply max_le (by norm_num)
        have hh := div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2) (Real.log_nonpos hx hx1)) hL.le
        linarith⟩

/-- The coordinate in [0,1] is an actual clipped logarithmic amplitude. -/
theorem schmidtScalePoint_coe (L x : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) (hx : 0≤x) (hx1 : x≤1) :
    ((schmidtScalePoint L x hL hx hx1).val:ℝ)=max 0 (1+2*Real.log x/L) := rfl

/-- Nonnegligible amplitudes and a middle product lie in one common scale band. -/
theorem schmidt_pair_in_scaleBand (L d η x y : ℝ)
    (hL : 0<L) (hη : 0≤η) (hx : 0≤x) (hy : 0≤y) (hx1 : x≤1) (hy1 : y≤1)
    (hxl : Real.exp (-(1+η)*L/2)≤x) (hyl : Real.exp (-(1+η)*L/2)≤y)
    (hlo : Real.exp ((d/2-1-η)*L)≤x*y)
    (hhi : x*y≤Real.exp ((d/2-1+η)*L)) :
    |((schmidtScalePoint L x hL hx hx1).val:ℝ)+
      ((schmidtScalePoint L y hL hy hy1).val:ℝ)-d|≤4*η := by
  have hxP : 0<x := (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hxl
  have hyP : 0<y := (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hyl
  have hxyP : 0<x*y := mul_pos hxP hyP
  have hlx := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hxP).2 hxl
  have hly := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hyP).2 hyl
  have hprodlo := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hxyP).2 hlo
  have hprodhi := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hxyP).2 hhi
  rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hxP) (ne_of_gt hyP)] at hprodlo hprodhi
  let u := 1+2*Real.log x/L
  let v := 1+2*Real.log y/L
  have hu : -η≤u := by
    have hh : -(1+η)≤2*Real.log x/L := (le_div_iff₀ hL).2 (by nlinarith)
    dsimp [u];linarith
  have hv : -η≤v := by
    have hh : -(1+η)≤2*Real.log y/L := (le_div_iff₀ hL).2 (by nlinarith)
    dsimp [v];linarith
  have hslo : d-2-2*η≤2*(Real.log x+Real.log y)/L :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hL).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hshi : 2*(Real.log x+Real.log y)/L≤d-2+2*η :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hL).2 (by nlinarith)
  have he : u+v=2+2*(Real.log x+Real.log y)/L := by dsimp [u,v];ring
  have hcux : u≤max 0 u := le_max_right _ _
  have hcvx : v≤max 0 v := le_max_right _ _
  have hcu : max 0 u≤u+η := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hcv : max 0 v≤v+η := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [schmidtScalePoint_coe,schmidtScalePoint_coe]
  change |max 0 u+max 0 v-d|≤4*η
  apply abs_le.2
  constructor <;> linarith

end APPTReview
files.PairLocalization.lean:
import FinitePairMass
import WeightedLocalization

open scoped BigOperators NNReal
open MeasureTheory Set
namespace APPTReview

/-- An arbitrary middle selection is controlled by its scale-band mass and the
mass of exceptional coordinates. Every pair is counted with the exact factor two. -/
theorem selected_pair_mass_bound {m : ℕ} (p : Fin m → ℝ) (x : Fin m → ScaleInterval)
    (hp : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hs : (∑ i,p i)=1)
    (C : Fin m → Fin m → Prop) [DecidableRel C]
    (bad : Fin m → Prop) [DecidablePred bad] (d t : ℝ)
    (hcover : ∀ i j,C i j →
      |((x i).val:ℝ)+((x j).val:ℝ)-d|≤t ∨ bad i ∨ bad j) :
    (∑ q : UpperPair m,if C q.val.1 q.val.2 then p q.val.1*p q.val.2 else 0) ≤
      ((scaleLift (finiteAtomicProbability p x hp hs)).prod
        (scaleLift (finiteAtomicProbability p x hp hs))).toMeasure.real (scaleBand d t)/2+
      (∑ i,if bad i then p i else 0) := by
  classical
  let F : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ := fun i j =>
    if |((x i).val:ℝ)+((x j).val:ℝ)-d|≤t then p i*p j else 0
  let H : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ := fun i j =>
    (if bad i then p i else 0)*p j+p i*(if bad j then p j else 0)
  have hp0 (i) : 0≤(if bad i then p i else 0) := by split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have hF0 (i j) : 0≤F i j := by
    dsimp [F]
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (hp i) (hp j)
    · exact le_rfl
  have hH0 (i j) : 0≤H i j := by dsimp [H];exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hp0 i) (hp j)) (mul_nonneg (hp i) (hp0 j))
  have hc (i j) : (if C i j then p i*p j else 0)≤F i j+H i j := by
    by_cases hh : C i j
    · rw [ite_eq_left hh]
      rcases hcover i j hh with hb | hb | hb
      · change p i*p j≤(if _ then p i*p j else 0)+H i j
        rw [ite_eq_left hb]
        linarith [hH0 i j]
      · dsimp only [H]
        rw [ite_eq_left hb]
        linarith [hF0 i j,mul_nonneg (hp i) (hp0 j)]
      · dsimp only [H]
        rw [ite_eq_left hb]
        linarith [hF0 i j,mul_nonneg (hp0 i) (hp j)]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hh]
      exact add_nonneg (hF0 i j) (hH0 i j)
  have hFs : ∀ i j,F i j=F j i := by intro i j; dsimp [F];rw [add_comm ((x i).val:ℝ),mul_comm (p i)]
  have hHs : ∀ i j,H i j=H j i := by intro i j; dsimp [H];ring
  have hFsum := upperPair_mass_le_half F hFs (fun i => hF0 i i)
  have hHsum := upperPair_mass_le_half H hHs (fun i => hH0 i i)
  have hHmass : (∑ i,∑ j,H i j)=2*(∑ i,if bad i then p i else 0) := by
    simp only [H,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul,hs,mul_one,one_mul]
    ring
  have hmass := atomic_scaleBand_mass p x hp hs d t
  change _=∑ i,∑ j,F i j at hmass
  have htotal := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q (_ : q∈(Finset.univ : Finset (UpperPair m))) => hc q.val.1 q.val.2)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at htotal
  rw [hHmass] at hHsum
  rw [hmass]
  linarith

end APPTReview
files.SchmidtEmpirical.lean:
import LogScaleCoordinates
import PairLocalization

open scoped BigOperators NNReal
open MeasureTheory
namespace APPTReview

theorem unit_schmidt_entry_le_one {m : ℕ} (s : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hn : ∀ i,0≤s i) (hs : (∑ i,(s i)^2)=1) (i : Fin m) : s i≤1 := by
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j∈Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg (s j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [hs] at h
  nlinarith [hn i]

noncomputable def schmidtCoordinates {m : ℕ} (s : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hn : ∀ i,0≤s i) (hs : (∑ i,(s i)^2)=1) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) :
    Fin m → ScaleInterval := fun i => schmidtScalePoint L (s i) hL (hn i) (unit_schmidt_entry_le_one s hn hs i)

noncomputable def schmidtEmpirical {m : ℕ} (s : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hn : ∀ i,0≤s i) (hs : (∑ i,(s i)^2)=1) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) :
    ProbabilityMeasure ScaleInterval :=
  finiteAtomicProbability (fun i => (s i)^2) (schmidtCoordinates s hn hs L hL)
    (fun i => sq_nonneg (s i)) hs

theorem exp_half_square (a : ℝ) : (Real.exp (a/2))^2=Real.exp a := by
  rw [pow_two,← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- Coordinates below the logarithmic cutoff have uniformly vanishing total mass. -/
theorem small_schmidt_mass {m : ℕ} (s : Fin m → ℝ) (hn : ∀ i,0≤s i)
    (L η : ℝ) (hM : Real.exp L=(m:ℝ)) :
    (∑ i,if s i<Real.exp (-(1+η)*L/2) then (s i)^2 else 0)≤Real.exp (-η*L) := by
  have hle (i : Fin m) : (if s i<Real.exp (-(1+η)*L/2) then (s i)^2 else 0)≤Real.exp (-(1+η)*L) := by
    split_ifs with hi
    · rw [← exp_half_square]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hn i) hi.le 2
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i∈Finset.univ) => hle i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
  have he : (m:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(1+η)*L)=Real.exp (-η*L) := by
    rw [← hM,← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  exact hsum.trans_eq he

theorem schmidt_pair_square_mass {m : ℕ} (s : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hs : (∑ i,(s i)^2)=1) :
    (∑ p : UpperPair m,(s p.val.1*s p.val.2)^2)≤1/2 := by
  have h := upperPair_mass_le_half (fun i j => (s i)^2*(s j)^2)
    (fun i j => mul_comm _ _) (fun i => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul,hs,mul_one] at h
  simpa only [mul_pow] using h

end APPTReview
